title: US court asks Gautam Adani to disclose quid pro quo for closing bribery case against him
description: A United States court on July 8 directed Gautam Adani to disclose whether anything was promised, offered, exchanged or accepted by anyone in connection with the United States' government’s request to dismiss the criminal indictment against Adani and seven others in a bribery case [USA Vs Gautam Adani].Judge Nicholas G Garaufis of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York directed Adani to file an affidavit in this regard by July 15.The Court asked Adani to answer the
